meaning: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each invoice.
Human-readable invoice reference number.
Date on which the invoice was issued.
Date by which the invoice payment is due.
Unique identifier for the customer.
Name of the customer billed on the invoice.
Email address associated with the customer.
City where the customer is located.
State, province, or regional area of the customer.
Country where the customer is located.
Unique identifier for the vendor or supplier.
Name of the vendor or supplier associated with the invoice.
Identifier of the product listed on the invoice.
Category to which the invoiced product belongs.
Name or description of the invoiced product.
Number of units invoiced.
Price charged for one unit of the product.
Discount percentage applied to the invoice or product.
Tax percentage applied.
Amount before discount, tax, and other additional charges, as defined by the source dataset.
Monetary value of the discount applied.
Monetary value of tax charged.
Shipping or delivery cost charged.
Final invoice amount recorded in the stated currency.
Currency code used for the invoice amount, such as INR, USD, or EUR.
Method used or recorded for paying the invoice.
Recorded invoice payment status, such as Paid, Pending, Overdue, or Cancelled.
Recorded date associated with payment; cleaned workflow retains this only for Paid invoices.
Channel through which the order was placed.
Sales representative associated with the transaction.
Source-provided overdue indicator, represented numerically (0/1).
